item.coloph: slob dpon chen po rdo rje go chas mdzad pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa rdzogs so/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shd+ha ka ra warma dang / bod kyi lo tsA ba shAkya'i dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
